title: The Great Reshuffle
summary:
Trade flows around Russian crude oil exports are changing
On 24 February 2022, Russia invaded Ukraine. This triggered widespread condemnation and a broad range of sanctions. Western countries in particular have been targeting Russia's financial institutions, the country's oligarchs, and the Russian energy industry.
